```python
import requests
import json

# Google Geocoding API
def get_location(wonder):
    api_key = "YOUR_API_KEY"
    base_url = f"https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?address={wonder}&key={api_key}"
    response = requests.get(base_url)
    data = json.loads(response.text)
    return data["results"][0]["geometry"]["location"]

# YouTube Data API
def get_video(wonder):
    api_key = "YOUR_API_KEY"
    base_url = f"https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/search?part=snippet&q={wonder}&type=video&key={api_key}"
    response = requests.get(base_url)
    data = json.loads(response.text)
    return data["items"][0]["id"]["videoId"]

# Create a dictionary of wonders with their locations and video IDs
wonders = {
    "The Great Wall of China": get_location("The Great Wall of China"),
    "The Taj Mahal": get_location("The Taj Mahal"),
    "Machu Picchu": get_location("Machu Picchu"),
    "Chichén Itzá": get_location("Chichén Itzá"),
    "The Roman Colosseum": get_location("The Roman Colosseum"),
    "The Christ the Redeemer statue": get_location("The Christ the Redeemer statue"),
    "The Pyramids of Giza": get_location("The Pyramids of Giza")
}

video_ids = {

    "Machu Picchu": get_video("Machu Picchu"),

    "The Pyramids of Giza": get_video("The Pyramids of Giza")
}

    print(f"Video ID: {video_ids[wonder]}")
```

```python
    # Use Lastfm API to get artist information
    lastfm_api_key = "YOUR_LASTFM_API_KEY"
```

Here's a high-level example of how this could be implemented using Python:
```python
import os
import plivo
from mailgun import Mailgun

# Initialize Plivo client
plivo_client = plivo.Client(auth_id='your_auth_id', auth_token='your_auth_token')

# Initialize Mailgun client
mailgun_client = Mailgun('your_mailgun_domain', 'your_mailgun_api_key')

def forward_sms_as_email(sms_message):
    # Send email using Mailgun API
    mailgun_client.send_email(
        from_='your_from_email',
        to='user@example.com',
        subject='SMS from Plivo',
        text=sms_message
    )

def reply_to_sms_from_email(email_message):
    # Extract SMS message from email body
    sms_message = email_message.body

    # Send SMS using Plivo API
    plivo_client.messages.create(
        from_='your_plivo_number',
        to='recipient@example.com',
        text=sms_message
    )

# Receive SMS using Plivo API
@plivo_client.on('sms')
def receive_sms(sms_message):
    forward_sms_as_email(sms_message)

# Receive email using Mailgun API
@mailgun_client.on('email')
def receive_email(email_message):
    reply_to_sms_from_email(email_message)
```

```python
geocoding_base_url = "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json"

# Yelp API settings
yelp_api_key = "YOUR_API_KEY"
yelp_base_url = "https://api.yelp.com/v3/businesses/search"

def find_local_coffee_houses(location):
    # Geocode the location using Google Geocoding API
    geocoding_params = {
        "address": location,
        "key": geocoding_api_key
    }
    geocoding_response = requests.get(geocoding_base_url, params=geocoding_params)
    geocoding_data = geocoding_response.json()
    latitude = geocoding_data["results"][0]["geometry"]["location"]["lat"]
    longitude = geocoding_data["results"][0]["geometry"]["location"]["lng"]

    # Search for coffee houses using Yelp API
    yelp_params = {
        "latitude": latitude,
        "longitude": longitude,
        "radius": 1000,  # search within 1 km
        "categories": "coffee",
        "limit": 10
    }
    yelp_headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {yelp_api_key}"
    }
    yelp_response = requests.get(yelp_base_url, params=yelp_params, headers=yelp_headers)
    yelp_data = yelp_response.json()

    # Return the list of coffee houses
    return yelp_data["businesses"]

# Example usage:
```
